# Stride Podiatry

> Mobile podiatry service providing home visits across Adelaide, South Australia. There is no clinic: all care is delivered in private homes, retirement villages, residential aged care facilities and supported living settings.

Stride Podiatry is run by Luke Wheldale, a podiatrist who completed his Bachelor of Podiatry at the University of South Australia in 2020.

## Key facts

- Service type: home-visit (mobile) podiatry only, no clinic location
- Coverage: all Adelaide metropolitan areas (northern, southern, eastern, western and central Adelaide), with regional South Australia by arrangement
- Hours: Monday to Friday, 8:00am to 5:00pm
- Phone: 08 8166 7589
- Email: info@stridepodiatry.com.au
- Booking: https://stridepodiatry.com.au/booking (no referral needed for private patients)
- Funding: Medicare CDM, NDIS (plan- and self-managed), DVA and Support at Home accepted where applicable

## Services

- [Home Visit Podiatry](https://stridepodiatry.com.au/services/home-visit-podiatry): routine foot care, treatment and assessment at home
- [Aged Care Podiatry](https://stridepodiatry.com.au/services/aged-care-podiatry): regular care for older adults at home and in facilities
- [NDIS Podiatry](https://stridepodiatry.com.au/services/ndis-podiatry): home visits for plan- and self-managed participants
- [Support at Home Podiatry](https://stridepodiatry.com.au/services/support-at-home-podiatry): funded in-home podiatry for older adults
- [DVA Podiatry](https://stridepodiatry.com.au/services/dva-podiatry): home visits for eligible veterans
- [General Podiatry Care](https://stridepodiatry.com.au/services/general-podiatry): nails, corns, calluses and skin care
- [Ingrown Toenail Treatment](https://stridepodiatry.com.au/services/ingrown-toenail)
- [Diabetes Foot Care](https://stridepodiatry.com.au/services/diabetes-foot-care): assessments, risk screening and ongoing care
- [Custom Orthotics](https://stridepodiatry.com.au/services/custom-orthotics): assessment, 3D scanning and fitting at home
- [Heel & Arch Pain](https://stridepodiatry.com.au/services/heel-arch-pain)
- [Biomechanics & Gait](https://stridepodiatry.com.au/services/biomechanics-gait)
- [Sports Podiatry](https://stridepodiatry.com.au/services/sports-podiatry)
- [Forefoot Pain](https://stridepodiatry.com.au/services/forefoot-pain)
- [Footwear Advice](https://stridepodiatry.com.au/services/footwear-advice)
